tara-marketing: Hey @eli-runtime quick ask for the launch post + webinar — can runtime produce a small reproducibility bundle we can attach to the PR and share with press?

eli-runtime: Sure. What should be in the bundle?

tara-marketing: Minimal and verifiable: 4 canonical payloads (short, medium, long, extra-long), a timings CSV with p50/p95/p99, one cold-start trace, one steady-state trace, and a one-paragraph runnote describing warmup and batching. Also a 1-line press blurb with exact numbers we can quote.

priya-eng: Which model and infra? Demo model or flagship?

tara-marketing: Use rwd-demo-2b on dedicated-gpu-12 so numbers are stable. If that machine isn't free, include hosted-run caveats. Sequence distribution: 50% <=64, 30% 65-512, 20% 513-2048.

eli-runtime: Plan: micro-sweep 500 requests, batching off, 50 warmup requests, collect token/sec and latencies. Will include provenance.txt (instance id, kernel, driver, docker tag). ETA 18h.

demo-ops: Please add demo/run-local.sh with exact curl and env vars. We want copy-pasteable commands for the laptop demo.

eli-runtime: Will add run-local.sh and an example curl: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' -d '{"model":"rwd-demo-2b","input":"Explain X"}'

tara-marketing: If int8 quantized numbers are included, mark them 'preliminary' if variance >10% vs fp16. Do not overclaim.

eli-runtime: Understood. If int8 noise present we'll include raw traces and a note.

bench-bot: micro-bench job #90211 queued by eli-runtime. Logs: /bench/90211.

tara-marketing: Thanks. If anything slips on timing, we can drop the extra-long payload and still ship.

bench-bot: micro-bench #90211 finished. Artifacts uploaded to /bench/90211/artifacts.tar.gz (sha256: 9f8e7d...).
